other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual farmer, a farmers’ group, a Farmers Producer Organisation (FPO), a cooperative society, or a registered institution
Applicant must have agricultural land of at least 0.25 acres and not more than 10 acres (maximum 25 acres for a cluster area)
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1 lakh per acre for standard crops and up to ₹2 lakh per acre for premium crops, paid in two installments subject to 75% plant survival.
